props.description: The doorway back to the gallery, standing open.
An open doorway north. Nothing bars it.
A shrine in the west aisle, its niche empty except for a smear of old wax.
A small iron-bound reliquary, set before the shrine. The latch yields to a touch.

props.revealHint: The shrine's empty niche is not quite empty — a seam runs behind the offering-stone. Searching the shrine would find it.
props.description: A shallow niche behind the shrine, holding a folded strip of cloth and a cracked votive.
A chapel pillar, its capital chewed by damp.
Its partner toward the north door, the carving worn to a suggestion of wings.
A huddle of unlit candles on the north-west wall.
A faded chapel banner, the saint's face washed out.
A wooden chair facing the shrine, as if someone had been at prayer.
A standing lantern, unlit, by the north-east corner.
A cobweb spanning the west wall, grey with chapel dust.

dmNotes.overview: A chapel cut into the stone, narrower than the gallery. A shrine stands in the west aisle with a small reliquary before it. Sconces line the walls, cold. An open door north, an open door south.
dmNotes.sensory: Wax and old incense. The air is still. When someone moves, the cold sconces seem to listen.
dmNotes.theDoor: Both doors stand open. A fight is the only thing that would stop them walking through.

fires.lit: The wall sconces are cold, wax pooled and dark.
fires.moved: The sconces have caught — a line of flame along both walls, as if something ahead has noticed you.
